storyCards.headline: Escapade: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Janet Jackson's "Escapade" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Escapade" is a song by American singer Janet Jackson from her fourth studio album, Janet Jackson's Rhythm Nation 1814 (1989).

It was written and produced by Jackson and Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis.

The song was released on January 8, 1990, by A&M Records as the third single (fourth in the United Kingdom) from Janet Jackson's Rhythm Nation 1814 (1989).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.
